purpose: Define aggregate-only state-validity checks that structurally qualifying BIEN family x trait systems must pass before raw trait values or biological turnover responses can be opened.

allowed_internal_uses: test numeric castability for predeclared continuous traits
compute species medians without returning them
count distinct states without returning state labels
compute category frequency ranks to test whether a unique modal state exists
forbidden_outputs: row-level species names paired with values
any trait dissimilarity or turnover effect

continuous_scalar_gate.numeric_castability: 100% of nonmissing eligible measurements must parse as finite numeric values
continuous_scalar_gate.unit_rule: exactly one distinct nonempty unit label within each family x trait system; multiple or missing physical units cause HOLD with no posthoc conversion in the primary BIEN lane

spatial_species_rule.additional_variation: at least 2 distinct numeric measurement values within the species

nominal_categorical_gate.unit_rule: after trim/lowercase, every non-null unit label must be in the predeclared nonphysical-token set; otherwise HOLD
nominal_categorical_gate.temporal_species_state: unique modal category; ties are unresolved and excluded
nominal_categorical_gate.temporal_variation: at least 2 distinct modal states across resolvable species

spatial_species_rule.additional_variation: at least 2 distinct category states within the species

joint_semantic_pass: A family x trait system must already pass v0.2 structural support, be assigned continuous_scalar or nominal_categorical in v0.3, and pass all type-specific state-validity rules above.

independence_gate.rule: After semantic filtering and later phylogeny crosswalk, at least 12 families must retain at least one eligible trait system; thresholds are never lowered.
